text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, is it that time already?
Guess I better head to training...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O flower, opening your lovely petals at the storefront.
...Did you not just speak to me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I want the beautiful 'Supreme Monarch' to look at me."
"I want to become the sparkle that adorns the 'Supreme Monarch'"... they say.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah—forgive me, lovely flowers.
Forgive my sinful magnificence that enchants you so!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me repay you...
by dedicating my time to speak with all of you!

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, welcome~!
What kind of flowers are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Every single flower in this shop, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she spent her time talking with the flowers in the shop,
neglecting her training altogether...
